steps.hardClue: Repair the observatory device with two components and defend it to unlock Pack-a-Punch.
steps.clue: Repair the Harmonic Oculus with its two missing components and defend it to unlock Pack-a-Punch.

steps.hardClue: Destroy the roaming robot with three different traps to obtain the Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Defeat O.S.C.A.R. with three contraptions to obtain the LGM-1.

steps.hardClue: Eavesdrop on the robot, enter the planet code and recover the chamber key.
steps.clue: Eavesdrop on O.S.C.A.R., enter the planet code and recover the Cryo Chamber Key.

steps.hardClue: Extract the scientist’s brain, defend it during a lockdown and install it in the machine.
steps.clue: Extract Thurston’s brain, defend the Perfusion Machine and install it in Machina Astralis.

steps.hardClue: Enter the planet’s coordinates, solve the reading-list puzzle and recover the missing planet.
steps.clue: Enter Mars’s coordinates, solve Thurston’s Reading List and recover Neptune.

steps.hardClue: Install the missing planet and align three planets with their indicated directions.
steps.clue: Install Neptune and align the three planets with their indicated directions.

steps.hardClue: Defend the portal from incoming drones, then travel through the portal.
steps.clue: Defend the portal from O.S.C.A.R.’s drones and travel to Mars.

steps.hardClue: Install the machine, shoot five distant pylons in order and capture the flying object.
steps.clue: Install the Perfusion Machine, shoot the pylons in order and capture the Ascendant Eye.

steps.hardClue: Place the captured object and activate five pillars with the Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Place the Ascendant Eye and activate the five pillars with the LGM-1.

steps.hardClue: Interact with the pillars in the correct sequence, then defeat the boss.
steps.clue: Interact with the Mars pillars in the Harmonic Oculus sequence, then defeat Caltheris.
